text.answer: Scalemail grants stacking bonus armor and magic resistance from takedowns on large minions, monsters, and champions.
text.counterplay: Account for her growing defenses when committing to a fight.

For each stack, Shyvana gains bonus armor and bonus magic resist.

text.answer: Inferno Aegis grants a shield and movement speed, with a stronger shield near enemy champions and more speed while facing visible enemy champions. It consumes the shield to explode for nearby magic damage, automatically when the shield expires or breaks. In Dragon Form, hitting an enemy champion with the explosion heals her.
text.counterplay: Create distance during her shield and avoid clustering around her.

text.answer: Molten Burst fires a fireball that explodes on the first enemy or at maximum range, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. In Dragon Form, it becomes wider, passes through enemies, deals increased damage, and triggers explosions on champions, large monsters, and at maximum range. It also leaves scorched ground that continually deals magic damage.
text.counterplay: Sidestep the fireball and leave scorched ground; avoid lining up with allies during Dragon Form.

citations.quote: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them for a moment.

text.answer: Dragon's Descent requires full Fury and transforms Shyvana during a dash with displacement immunity, dealing cone magic damage and briefly fearing enemies. Dragon Form grants bonus health and attack range and empowers her basic abilities. Fury builds over time in Human Form and from damaging attacks and abilities; Dragon Form drains Fury and ends when it is depleted.
text.counterplay: Watch her Fury before approaching, avoid the dash's cone, and disengage during Dragon Form.
